(Capacity: 20,545) |champion= |tourney= [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First Round }} {{2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Kentucky]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Wildcats, founding members of the [[Southeastern Conference]], played their home games at [[Rupp Arena]] and were led by [[John Calipari]] in his 13th season as head coach. The Wildcats finished the season 26–8, 14–4 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish a tie for second place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they defeated [[2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] in the quarterfinals before losing to [[2021–22 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] in the semifinals. They received an at large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 seed in the East region. The Wildcats became just the 10th No. 2 seed to lose in the first round of the NCAA Tournament, losing to No. 15-seeded (and eventual regional runner-up) [[2021–22 Saint Peter's Peacocks basketball team|Saint Peter's]] 85–79 in overtime. It also marked the first time Kentucky had suffered a First Round exit under Calipari, and allowed eventual tournament champion [[Kansas Jayhawks basketball|Kansas]] to take the [[List of teams with the most victories in NCAA Division I men's college basketball|all-time record for most wins in Division I men's college basketball history.]] ==Previous season== In a season disrupted by the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]] restrictions, the [[2020–21 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] a disappointing 9–16, 8–9 in [[2020–21 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in eighth place. undrafted |} ===2021 recruiting class=== On October 26, 2020, [[Bryce Hopkins]] committed to UK over offers from [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]] and [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]]. Hopkins was the first commitment in the 2021 recruiting class and the No. 9 ranked power forward in the 2021 class by 247Sports. He was a consensus four-star player by the four main recruiting services and was ranked No. 38 overall by 247Sports. On October 31, 2020, [[Daimion Collins]] committed to UK over offers from [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]] and [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma]]. Collins was the second commitment in the 2021 recruiting class and the No. 2 ranked power forward in the 2021 class by 247Sports. He was a consensus five-star player by the four main recruiting services and was ranked No. 10 overall by 247Sports. On May 12, 2021, [[TyTy Washington]] committed to UK over offers from Arizona, Baylor, Kansas, LSU and Oregon. Washington was the third commitment in the 2021 recruiting class and the No. 1 ranked point guard in the 2021 class by 247Sports.
